descriptionMarkdown:
Faction relics are named or storied objects. Their provenance matters as much as their rules: carrying one can create 
authority, suspicion, obligations or enemies.
Relic Availability Effect
The Last Light - Imperial Near-Unique
Lasgun: 1d10 radiant; 100/300 ft; Accurate, Armour-Breaking, Reload 30. 
Once per short rest on a hit, choose a second creature directly behind the 
target within 30 ft; if the original attack roll would hit it, it takes 1d10 radiant 
damage.
Bulwark of Saint Drusus - Imperial Near-Unique
Refractor relic. Once per short rest, reaction to reduce damage to you by 
2d8 + proficiency bonus; allies within 5 ft reduce the same instance of area 
damage by your proficiency bonus. Burden: Ecclesiarchal or Inquisitorial 
ownership is likely.
Martyr's Censer - Imperial Exceptional
Once per long rest as an action, for 1 minute, allies within 15 ft have 
advantage on fear and Corruption saves. Daemons and explicitly corrupted 
creatures that start their turn in the aura take radiant damage equal to your 
proficiency bonus.
Arc of the Reductor - Mechanicus Near-Unique
Arc rifle: 2d8 lightning; 80/240 ft; Shock, Armour-Breaking, Mechanicus, 
Reload 8. Once per short rest, a hit against a machine, vehicle or structure 
becomes a critical hit.
Omnissian Data-Relic - 
Mechanicus Near-Unique
While interfaced, gain +1 to Technology checks and advantage to identify 
Mechanicus systems. Once per short rest, reroll a failed Technology check. 
Burden: the Cult Mechanicus regards the device as institutional property.
Big Lug's Door - Ogryn Near-Unique
+2 AC; Ogryn only; counts as a Slab Shield. If you did not move this turn, 
one Small or Medium ally directly behind you has Full Cover. Once per 
short rest when a ranged attack misses you, move 5 ft toward the attacker 
without provoking opportunity attacks.
Relic Availability Effect
Grutt's Lucky Club - Ogryn Exceptional
2d6 bludgeoning; Melee; Ogryn, Heavy, Brutal. Once per short rest when 
you miss with it, reroll the attack. If the reroll hits a Large or smaller target, it 
must pass a Strength save or be pushed 10 ft.
Ancestor-Wrought Rail Rifle - Kin Near-Unique
2d10 force; 150/450 ft; Accurate, Heavy, Armour-Breaking, Reload 2. Once 
per short rest, one attack ignores Light and Heavy Cover and one source of 
resistance to its weapon damage.
Oathplate of the First Claim - Kin Near-Unique
AC 17, max Dex +1; Kin only; no Speed penalty. Once per short rest, 
ignore one effect that would shove, knock you prone, or reduce your Speed. 
Allies within 5 ft gain +1 to saves against forced movement while you are 
conscious.
Ghosthelm of the Wandering Seer 
- Aeldari Near-Unique
Aeldari Warlock or GM-approved Psyker. Once per long rest when Perils 
trigger, treat the severity result as Warp Static. After resolving it, reduce 
your Warp Pressure by your proficiency bonus, minimum 0.
Starfall Long Rifle - Aeldari Near-Unique
1d10 piercing; 180/720 ft; Accurate, Silent, Monomolecular, Reload 6. If you 
are Hidden and did not move this turn, attacks with it score a critical hit on 
19-20. Once per short rest, ignore Heavy Cover on one attack.
